title: Basic C# Programming — Comprehensive Practice Quiz (Earlier and Current Notes)
description: A deeper, mixed-format practice quiz based on available Eduvos Basic C# Programming notes: Lessons 1–7 and 10–12. Includes C#/.NET foundations, OOP, variables and control flow, arrays and strings, classes and inheritance, preprocessor directives, Math and Random, overloading, exceptions, and namespaces. Lessons 8 and 9 were not included because their notes were not available among the files reviewed.
subject: Basic C# Programming

questions.question: What is C#?
options: A programming language commonly used with the .NET platform
answer: A programming language commonly used with the .NET platform
questions.explanation: The notes introduce C# as a programming language used with .NET.

questions.question: What is the primary role of the Common Language Runtime (CLR) in the .NET execution process described in the notes?
options: To provide the runtime environment in which .NET code executes
To write source code for the programmer
answer: To provide the runtime environment in which .NET code executes

questions.question: Arrange the main stages of the C# execution process in the order described in the notes.
options: JIT compilation converts intermediate code to machine code
The compiler produces Common Intermediate Language (CIL)
The CLR/runtime loads and executes the application
answer: C# source code is compiled
The compiler produces Common Intermediate Language (CIL)
The CLR/runtime loads and executes the application
JIT compilation converts intermediate code to machine code

questions.question: Which statement best distinguishes a class from an object?
options: A class is a template; an object is an instance created from it
A class is an instance; an object is a template
They mean exactly the same thing
An object can contain no data
answer: A class is a template; an object is an instance created from it

questions.question: Match each object-oriented programming term to its description.
options: A specific instance of a class
A template defining data and behaviours
An action an object can perform
answer: A template defining data and behaviours
A specific instance of a class
Information describing an object
An action an object can perform

questions.question: Which are the four OOP principles listed in the notes? Select all that apply.
answer: Abstraction
Encapsulation
Inheritance
Polymorphism

questions.question: A class keeps its data private and provides public methods or properties to control access. Which OOP principle does this most directly demonstrate?
answer: Encapsulation

questions.question: Which is the correct syntax for a single-line comment in C#?
answer: // comment

questions.question:
What is the value of result after this code executes?
int result = 7 / 2;
questions.explanation: Both operands are integers, so integer division discards the fractional part.

questions.question: What does the % operator return when used with integers?
answer: The remainder after division

questions.question: A variable's scope determines where in the program it can be accessed.
answer: True
Pass

questions.question:
How many times does this loop execute its body?
for (int i = 1; i <= 4; i++) { Console.WriteLine(i); }
Which loop checks its condition after executing the body, so the body runs at least once?
answer: do...while

questions.question: Which statements about break and continue are correct? Select all that apply.
options: break exits the nearest enclosing loop or switch
continue skips to the next loop iteration
continue always terminates the whole program
answer: break exits the nearest enclosing loop or switch
continue skips to the next loop iteration

questions.question: What is the index of the first element in a standard C# array?
options: It depends on the element's value

questions.question: Write the C# statement that declares an integer array containing 3, 6 and 9.
answer: int[] numbers = { 3, 6, 9 };

questions.question: Given string name = "Lerato";, what does name.Length return?
Match each C# conversion method to its usual purpose.
options: Converts a compatible value to an integer by casting/truncating the fractional part
Converts a compatible value to a double
Converts a string representation into an enum value
answer: Parses text into an integer

questions.explanation: Substring(1, 3) starts at index 1 and returns three characters.

questions.question: A foreach loop is useful for visiting each item in an array or other enumerable collection.
answer: True

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a constructor?
options: To initialise a newly created object
answer: To initialise a newly created object

questions.question: Which statement about a C# property is most accurate?
options: It can control access to an object's data through get and set accessors
It must always be a loop
It cannot be read after construction
It is another name for a namespace
answer: It can control access to an object's data through get and set accessors

questions.question: Write a valid C# method declaration for a public method named GetPrice that returns a double and takes no parameters.
answer: public double GetPrice()

questions.question: In a derived class constructor, what is the purpose of base(...) when used in the constructor initializer?
options: To call a constructor of the base class
answer: To call a constructor of the base class

questions.question: A method can be overloaded by changing only its return type while keeping its name and parameter list identical.
answer: False

questions.question: When are C# preprocessor directives such as #if evaluated, according to the notes?
options: Only when a user clicks a button
answer: During compilation

questions.question: Match each preprocessor directive to its role.
answer: Defines a symbol
Undefines a symbol
Forces a compiler warning
Forces a compilation error
Marks a collapsible code region

questions.question: A #error directive forces a compilation error that prevents the application from being compiled successfully.
answer: True

questions.question: Why can Math.Sqrt(81) be called without creating a Math object?
options: The compiler creates a new Math object every time
All classes are static by default
answer: Math is a static class

questions.question: What value does Math.Abs(-15) return?
What is the upper-bound behaviour of Random.Next(1, 5)?
options: It can return 1, 2, 3 or 4, but not 5
answer: It can return 1, 2, 3 or 4, but not 5

questions.question: Write a C# expression that returns a random integer from 1 through 6 using a Random object named rng.
answer: rng.Next(1, 7)

questions.question: Which pair of methods is a valid overload set?
options: int Add(int a, int b) and int Add(int a, int b, int c)
int Add(int a, int b) and double Add(int a, int b)
answer: int Add(int a, int b) and int Add(int a, int b, int c)

questions.question: In the notes, which syntax allows an object to be accessed using a string key as well as an integer index?
answer: An overloaded indexer

questions.question: If a class overloads the + operator, what can happen to the corresponding += operation?
options: It can use the overloaded + behaviour
It becomes illegal in every case
answer: It can use the overloaded + behaviour

questions.question: A program tries int.Parse("five"). Which catch block is the most appropriate specific handler?
answer: catch (FormatException)

questions.question: Why should catch (FormatException) generally appear before catch (Exception ex)?
options: The specific exception must be handled before the general handler can catch it
The general handler must be first
answer: The specific exception must be handled before the general handler can catch it

questions.question: Arrange the steps for creating and handling a custom exception in the logical order.
options: Catch the custom exception and respond to it
Define a class that derives from Exception
Use throw to raise an instance when a rule is violated
Provide a constructor/message for the custom exception
answer: Define a class that derives from Exception
Provide a constructor/message for the custom exception
Use throw to raise an instance when a rule is violated
Catch the custom exception and respond to it

questions.question: What does using System; allow in a C# file?
options: Use names from System without writing System. each time
Create a class named System automatically
answer: Use names from System without writing System. each time

questions.question: What is a using alias useful for?
options: Giving a long namespace or type path a shorter alternative name
Changing an int into a string automatically
answer: Giving a long namespace or type path a shorter alternative name

questions.question: Match each concept to the most accurate description.
options: Allows bracket-style access to an object
Groups names and helps avoid naming conflicts
Same method name with different parameter lists
Code that normally runs whether or not an exception occurs
answer: Same method name with different parameter lists
Allows bracket-style access to an object
Code that normally runs whether or not an exception occurs
Groups names and helps avoid naming conflicts

questions.question: A student enters text instead of a number in a registration program. Which practices can improve the program? Select all that apply.
options: Place the parse operation inside a try block
Catch FormatException and display a helpful message
Use finally for cleanup that must normally happen either way
answer: Place the parse operation inside a try block
Catch FormatException and display a helpful message
Use finally for cleanup that must normally happen either way

questions.question: Write the C# statement that declares a namespace named StudentRecords.
answer: namespace StudentRecords
